title: 課堂互動
description: 課堂上師生互動的常用對話

sentences.en: Could you please explain the concept that you mentioned at the beginning of today's lecture?
sentences.zh: 您能解釋一下您在今天講座開頭提到的那個概念嗎？

sentences.en: The professor, who has been teaching for over twenty years, always encourages students to participate actively in class.
sentences.zh: 那位教了超過二十年的教授總是鼓勵學生積極參與課堂。

sentences.en: Before we move on to the next chapter, I would like to summarize the key points we have discussed so far.
sentences.zh: 在我們進入下一章之前，我想總結一下我們到目前為止討論的重點。

sentences.en: The assignment, which is due next Monday, requires us to analyze three different case studies in detail.
sentences.zh: 那份下週一截止的作業要求我們詳細分析三個不同的案例研究。

sentences.en: Would anyone like to share their perspective on the issue that we have been debating for the past hour?
sentences.zh: 有人想分享一下對我們過去一小時一直在辯論的議題的看法嗎？

sentences.en: Having reviewed all the submissions, the teacher decided to give the class an extension on the deadline.
sentences.zh: 在審閱了所有提交的作業後，老師決定給全班延長截止日期。

sentences.en: I apologize for interrupting, but I think there might be an error on the slide that is currently being displayed.
sentences.zh: 抱歉打斷一下，但我認為目前顯示的投影片上可能有一個錯誤。

sentences.en: The students, eager to understand the material better, stayed after class to ask additional questions.
sentences.zh: 那些渴望更好理解教材的學生們下課後留下來問了更多問題。

sentences.en: According to the syllabus that was distributed at the start of the semester, we should be covering chapter five today.
sentences.zh: 根據學期初發放的教學大綱，我們今天應該要上第五章。

sentences.en: If you have any concerns about your grade, please feel free to visit me during my office hours this week.
sentences.zh: 如果你對成績有任何疑慮，歡迎在這週的辦公時間來找我。

sentences.en: The group presentation, which accounts for thirty percent of our final grade, will be held next Thursday.
sentences.zh: 那個佔我們期末成績百分之三十的小組報告將在下週四進行。

sentences.en: Let me clarify what I meant by that statement, since several of you seem to have misunderstood my point.
sentences.zh: 讓我澄清一下那句話的意思，因為你們幾位似乎誤解了我的觀點。

sentences.en: The textbook, written by a renowned scholar in the field, provides comprehensive coverage of all the topics we need.
sentences.zh: 那本由該領域知名學者撰寫的教科書全面涵蓋了我們需要的所有主題。

sentences.en: Rather than simply memorizing the formulas, I encourage you to understand the underlying principles behind them.
sentences.zh: 與其單純背公式，我鼓勵你們理解背後的基本原理。

sentences.en: The student who submitted the most creative project will receive extra credit, as announced at the beginning of the term.
sentences.zh: 提交最有創意專案的學生將獲得額外加分，這在學期初就已經宣布了。

sentences.en: Since we are running short on time, I will post the remaining lecture notes on the course website tonight.
sentences.zh: 由於時間不夠了，我今晚會把剩餘的講義上傳到課程網站。

sentences.en: Please raise your hand if you need me to repeat the instructions that I just gave for the lab exercise.
sentences.zh: 如果你需要我重複剛才給的實驗練習指示，請舉手。

sentences.en: The class, consisting of both undergraduate and graduate students, offers a unique opportunity for collaborative learning.
sentences.zh: 這門由大學生和研究生共同組成的課提供了獨特的合作學習機會。

sentences.en: Although the topic may seem difficult at first, I assure you that it will become clearer as we work through more examples.
sentences.zh: 雖然這個主題一開始可能看起來很難，但我保證隨著我們做更多例題，它會變得更清楚。

sentences.en: For those of you who missed last week's class, the recorded lecture is available on the learning management system.
sentences.zh: 對於上週缺課的同學，錄製的講座可以在學習管理系統上觀看。

sentences.en: The teaching assistant, who holds a master's degree in linguistics, will be leading the discussion sections every Friday.
sentences.zh: 那位擁有語言學碩士學位的助教每週五會帶領討論課。

sentences.en: I would appreciate it if everyone could complete the assigned reading before coming to class tomorrow morning.
sentences.zh: 如果大家能在明天早上來上課前完成指定閱讀，我會很感激。

sentences.en: Based on the feedback I received from the midterm evaluations, I have decided to adjust my teaching approach slightly.
sentences.zh: 根據我從期中評量收到的回饋，我決定稍微調整我的教學方式。

sentences.en: The diagram on the whiteboard, which illustrates the relationship between the variables, should help you understand the concept.
sentences.zh: 白板上那個說明變數之間關係的圖表應該能幫助你們理解這個概念。

sentences.en: Working in pairs, please discuss the three questions listed on page forty-seven and prepare to share your answers.
sentences.zh: 請兩人一組討論第四十七頁列出的三個問題，並準備分享你們的答案。

sentences.en: The research paper, which must be written in APA format, should include at least fifteen peer-reviewed sources.
sentences.zh: 那篇必須以APA格式撰寫的研究論文應該包含至少十五個經過同儕審查的資料來源。

sentences.en: Considering that many students struggled with the last assignment, I have prepared additional practice materials for review.
sentences.zh: 考慮到很多學生在上次作業上遇到困難，我準備了額外的練習材料供複習。

sentences.en: The laboratory session, scheduled for Wednesday afternoon, will give you hands-on experience with the equipment we discussed.
sentences.zh: 排在週三下午的實驗課將讓你們親手操作我們討論過的設備。

sentences.en: I strongly recommend that you form study groups, as collaborative learning has been shown to improve academic performance significantly.
sentences.zh: 我強烈建議你們組成讀書小組，因為合作學習已被證實能顯著提升學業表現。

sentences.en: Before submitting your final essay, make sure to proofread it carefully and check that all citations are properly formatted.
sentences.zh: 在提交期末論文之前，請確保仔細校對並檢查所有引用的格式是否正確。
